The unidentified [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''ancient Dantooinian fungi''' were a species of [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] native to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], nearly extinct by [[3622 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref><ref name="Fungal Protection" /> Found in the crystal caves, this fungi species looked visually similar to Dantooinian [[Glowshroom]]s,<ref name="dantooine">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> and were emitting light of blue, yellow, or purple colors.<ref name="Fungal Protection" />

[[File:DantShroomYellow-SWTOR.png|left|thumb|A yellow variant of the ancient fungi]]
When around 3622 BBY,<ref name="Date" /> a [[research vessel]] known as the ''[[Jannimak]]'' crashed on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooinian]] surface, the ship's automatic systems [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] the [[Jannimak crash site|surrounding environment]] to accommodate exotic species that were on board of the ''Jannimak''. The transformed environment in the [[Geothermal Disruption]] zone of the crash turned out to be ideal for the ancient fungi, that thrived in the new warmed conditions. The ''Jannimak'' also brough with it [[Geo Beast|Geo beasts]], which [[Larva/Legends|larvae]] became attracted to the ancient fungi. To protect the endangered species from Geo beasts and to collect samples for preservation and study, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Kontor]] of the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]] sent in GSI contractors.<ref name="Fungal Protection">{{TORcite|Fungal Protection|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', ancient Dantooinian fungi have the same 3D model as that of [[Glowshroom]]s and unidentified [[Voss]] mushrooms.
